historical_record.description: The general manager reported the opening and dedication of the new Sidney Peixotto Playground, formerly Beaver Playground, set for February 24; it was later put back to March.
The Recreation Commission awarded the contract to build the Fifteenth Street field house, at 15th and Beaver Streets, to Andrew L. Waechter.

The Recreation Commission named the Fifteenth and Beaver Streets project the Sidney S. Peixotto Playground, for the late Sidney S. Peixotto, together with the Joseph Lee Recreation Center and the Alice Chalmers Playground.
